newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Police disperse south Albania investors' protest.
newsitem.headline: Police disperse south Albania investors' protest.

text.p: Riot police deployed water cannon and fired blank shots on Wednesday to break up a demonstration by impoverished Albanian depositors demanding refunds from failed pyramid investment schemes.

About 3,000 protesters demanding refunds and the resignation of the rightwing government had marched into the centre of the Adriatic port two weeks after violent protests against the collapse of the schemes had engulfed several cities. Police made mass arrests after last month's disturbances.

Marchers had initially gathered without incident in front of Vlore's Palace of Culture but police took action after protesters moved towards a city square and stadium. At least 10 people were bundled into police vans.

Investors in Europe's poorest country have begun using partial refunds of their stakes in two failed schemes but the process was marked by confusion and public frustration. Refunds were proceeding in the capital Tirana on Wendnesday with no indication of any tension.
